Lianqi Development Co., Ltd. v. Shanghai Baoye Group Co., Ltd., et al. — dispute over infringement of invention patent

Ruling Summary

Actions for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent and actions for patent infringement based on the same facts are both independent lawsuits. In judicial practice, how to determine the jurisdiction of the above two types of cases should follow the basic rules and characteristics of judicial activities and adhere to the "two conveniences" principle. It is not always necessary to transfer jurisdiction and consolidate the trials. As for whether there will be conflicts when the above two types of cases are tried separately by different courts, since appeals from both cases are uniformly heard by the Intellectual Property Court of the Supreme People's Court, this potential problem can be resolved through the appeal mechanism.

Civil Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2019) Zui Gao Fa Zhi Min Xia Zhong No. 2

Appellant (Defendant at First Instance): Shanghai Baoye Group Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 2457, Fuyuan Road, Baoshan District, Shanghai.

Legal Representative: Bai Xiaohu, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Chen Yanxian, patent attorney of Guangzhou Huaxue Intellectual Property Agency Co., Ltd.

Respondent (Plaintiff at First Instance): Lianqi Development Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 8, Zhongxin Road, Fenghuali, Xinshi District, Tainan City, Taiwan Region.

Legal Representative: Lin Rongjun, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Pan Lidong, lawyer of Guangdong Yuzi Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance: Chao Shijie International Technology (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 169, Chuangqiang Road, Yongning Street, Zengcheng District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province (within the core area of Zengcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone).

Legal Representative: Luo Zhenghao, Chairman and General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Chen Yanxian, patent attorney of Guangzhou Huaxue Intellectual Property Agency Co., Ltd.

Defendant at First Instance: China Construction First Bureau (Group) Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 52, West Fourth Ring South Road, Fengtai District, Beijing.

Legal Representative: Luo Shiwei, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Chen Yanxian, patent attorney of Guangzhou Huaxue Intellectual Property Agency Co., Ltd.

Defendant at First Instance: Baisheng Engineering Co., Ltd. Domicile: Yinxiu Road 800-2101, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Guo Jianting, Chairman and General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Shao Jun, lawyer of Jiangsu Tuohong Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Shen Kaikai, lawyer of Jiangsu Tuohong Law Firm.

Defendant at First Instance: Jiangxi Hantang System Integration Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room 801, Comprehensive Building, Qindu Yujing, No. 956, East Beijing Road, Qingshanhu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province.

Legal Representative: Chen Baichen, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Chen Yanxian, patent attorney of Guangzhou Huaxue Intellectual Property Agency Co., Ltd.

Defendant at First Instance: China Electronics System Engineering No.2 Construction Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 888, Lixi Road, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Yang Liangsheng, General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Zhu Haiyan, patent attorney of Tahota Law Firm.

The Appellant Shanghai Baoye Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baoye Company) appealed against the civil ruling made by the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court on February 13, 2019, in cases (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu Nos. 3447 and 3448 concerning a dispute over infringement of invention patent with the Respondent Lianqi Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Lianqi Company), and the Defendants at First Instance Chao Shijie International Technology (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Chao Shijie Company), China Construction First Bureau (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as China Construction First Bureau), Baisheng Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Baisheng Company), Jiangxi Hantang System Integration Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hantang Company), and China Electronics System Engineering No.2 Construction Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as China Electronics No.2 Construction), to this Court.

Baoye Company appealed requesting: to revoke the original ruling according to law and transfer this case to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for trial. Facts and reasons: Lianqi Company is domiciled in Tainan City, Taiwan Region, and Baoye Company is domiciled in Baoshan District, Shanghai. Moreover, the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court has already accepted the case of Shanghai Huiya Aluminum Alloy Products Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huiya Company) v. Lianqi Company for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent. Huiya Company is the manufacturer and seller of the allegedly infringing product in this case. This case should be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for consolidated trial.

Lianqi Company argued: The places where the alleged infringing acts in the two invention patent infringement lawsuits filed by Lianqi Company occurred and the domiciles of the defendants are located in Zengcheng District, Guangzhou City. The original trial court has jurisdiction over this case. The two infringement lawsuits involve product patent and method patent respectively. Compared with the action for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent filed by Huiya Company, the parties are different, the forms of infringement are different, the applicable laws are not entirely the same, and the method patent involved is not the same patent as in the action for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent filed by Huiya Company. Moreover, the original trial court has seized the "Qishitong" product involved in the case and can make a more objective judgment on whether there is infringement. The two cases should not be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for consolidated trial with the action for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent accepted by that court.

Upon review, the original trial court held that both cases are disputes over infringement of invention patent. Since the domicile of one of the defendants, Chao Shijie Company, is located in Zengcheng District, Guangzhou City, which is within the jurisdiction of the original trial court, the original trial court has jurisdiction over both cases. Furthermore, from the preliminary evidence and evidence preservation in this case, the suspected infringing "Qishitong" construction method and the use location of the "Qishitong" product are both within the Zengcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. Pursuant to Article 24 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Zengcheng District, Guangzhou City is the place where the alleged infringing acts occurred in these two cases, and the original trial court also has jurisdiction over these two cases according to law. Therefore, the jurisdictional objection raised by Baoye Company lacks factual and legal basis. The court ruled: to reject the jurisdictional objection raised by Baoye Company in these two cases. The acceptance fees for the jurisdictional objection in these two cases total RMB 200 (RMB 100 for each case), to be borne by Baoye Company.

This Court finds that on November 14, 2018, Lianqi Company simultaneously filed two patent infringement lawsuits with the original trial court: The first is a product patent infringement lawsuit, in which Lianqi Company requested the court to order the defendant to cease infringing on its invention patent with patent number ZL200410048826.1, titled "Molding device for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," case number (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu No. 3448. In that case, the original trial court ruled to seal up or seize the "Qishitong" products used by the defendants in the construction project for the 10.5-generation TFT-LCD display production line within the Zengcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province. The second is a method patent infringement lawsuit, in which Lianqi Company requested the court to order the defendant to cease infringing on its invention patent with patent number ZL200810083903.5, titled "Construction method for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," case number (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu No. 3447. In that case, the original trial court ruled to preserve evidence of the "Qishitong" construction method used by the defendants through methods such as photographing, audio recording, video recording, on-site inspection, and making transcripts. Additionally, it is found that on July 24, 2018, Huiya Company filed a lawsuit with the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court, requesting confirmation that its "Qishitong" product does not fall within the scope of protection of Lianqi Company's invention patent with patent number ZL200410048826.1, titled "Molding device for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," case number (2018) Hu 73 Min Chu No. 753. The Shanghai Intellectual Property Court accepted and tried the case.

Upon review, this Court holds that this case is a dispute over infringement of invention patent. Based on the parties' arguments and the facts found, the issues in dispute in this case are whether the original trial court has jurisdiction over this case and whether this case needs to be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for trial.

The Supreme People's Court once pointed out in the "Notice on Designating Jurisdiction in Patent Dispute Cases between Honda Motor Co., Ltd. and Shijiazhuang Shuanghuan Automobile Co., Ltd., and Beijing Xuyang Hengxing Economic and Trade Co., Ltd." [2004] Min San Ta Zi No. 4: "A lawsuit for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent and a lawsuit for patent infringement involving the same facts are lawsuits separately filed by the parties at different stages of the dispute process to protect their own rights under the Civil Procedure Law. Both are independent lawsuits. The lawsuit for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent filed by one party is not absorbed by the other party's separate filing of a patent infringement lawsuit. However, to avoid duplicate trials of cases involving the same facts by different courts, the people's court should transfer jurisdiction and consolidate the trial according to law." Based on the facts found, the patent that Lianqi Company seeks to protect in this case is the invention patent for "Molding device for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," which is the same patent for which Huiya Company requested confirmation of non-infringement in case (2018) Hu 73 Min Chu No. 753 filed with the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court, and the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court filed the case first. If only the above circumstances of these two cases are considered simply, according to the spirit of the above Notice, this case involves the same product patent as case (2018) Hu 73 Min Chu No. 753 accepted by the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court, and could be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court, which filed the case first, for consolidated trial.

However, Article 8 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "Parties to civil litigation have equal litigation rights. When trying civil cases, the people's court shall ensure and facilitate the exercise of litigation rights by the parties, and shall be equal in the application of law to the parties." When exercising its judicial power, the people's court should follow the basic rules and characteristics of judicial activities and adhere to the principles of facilitating party litigation and facilitating the people's court to exercise its judicial power independently, impartially, and efficiently.

In this case, the patent that Lianqi Company seeks to protect is the invention patent for "Molding device for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," which relates to a molding device for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs, particularly a molding device in which some components of the device are directly fixed to the concrete floor slab, and reserved openings are formed in the concrete floor slab. At the same time, Lianqi Company also filed another patent infringement lawsuit with the original trial court [case number (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu No. 3447], requesting legal protection for its invention patent titled "Construction method for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs," which relates to a construction method for reserved openings in concrete floor slabs, particularly a construction method in which some components of a molding device are directly fixed to the concrete floor slab, and reserved openings are formed in the concrete floor slab. The above two patents are respectively invention patents for a molding device and a construction method in the technical field of reserved openings in concrete floor slabs, and are closely related. Meanwhile, upon the application of the parties, the original trial court ruled in this case to seal up or seize the "Qishitong" products used by the defendants at first instance in the construction project for the 10.5-generation TFT-LCD display production line within the Zengcheng Economic and Technological Development Zone, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province; and in case (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu No. 3447, the original trial court ruled to preserve evidence of the "Qishitong" construction method used by the defendants at first instance through methods such as photographing, audio recording, video recording, on-site inspection, and making transcripts. In view of this, considering the overall facts of this case and the substantial connections among the three related cases, if this case were transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for consolidated trial, related cases would still be tried by different courts.

How to determine the competent court in this case should start from the convenience of party litigation and the convenience of the people's court in trial, comprehensively considering factors such as the facts of the related cases and the execution of judgments, and make a lawful and reasonable decision. First, from the principle of respecting and protecting the parties' right of action, the lawsuit for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent filed by Huiya Company with the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court and the two patent infringement lawsuits filed by Lianqi Company with the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court are all acts by the parties to autonomously exercise their right of action according to law, and all comply with the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law on litigation jurisdiction, and should be respected and protected according to law. Second, from the principle of facilitating party litigation, considering the specific circumstances of the parties in the three cases, the parties in the action for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent accepted by the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court are the plaintiff Huiya Company and the defendant Lianqi Company; the plaintiffs in the two patent infringement lawsuits accepted by the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court are both Lianqi Company, and the defendants are six entities including Baoye Company, Chao Shijie Company, China Construction First Bureau, Baisheng Company, Hantang Company, and China Electronics No.2 Construction. If this case were transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for trial, since the method patent infringement lawsuit would still be tried by the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court, the six defendants and Lianqi Company would have to participate in lawsuits in both Shanghai and Guangzhou respectively. The parties would spend more time and incur higher economic costs to participate in the lawsuits. If both patent infringement lawsuits are tried in the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court, it would be relatively more conducive to saving litigation costs for the parties, in line with the principle of litigation economy, and also more convenient for the majority of the parties to participate in the lawsuit. Third, from the principle of facilitating the people's court to exercise its judicial power impartially and efficiently, considering that the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court has also accepted the infringement case involving the construction method of the molding device patent which is highly related to the molding device patent in this case, and has already carried out evidence preservation of the "Qishitong" products and construction methods used in the project within its jurisdiction, trial of this case by the original trial court is convenient for party litigation and also convenient for the people's court to ascertain the facts of the case and render judgment and execute it according to law, thereby ensuring a fair and efficient conclusion of the case. Fourth, the basic spirit established by the Notice is that a lawsuit for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent and a lawsuit for patent infringement based on the same facts are independent lawsuits and should not absorb each other. As for how to determine jurisdiction in specific cases, this should be considered based on the specific circumstances of the case. Since there are two closely related lawsuits in addition to this case, which is significantly different from the case situation addressed and handled by the Notice, the actual circumstances of the three cases should be comprehensively considered to make the relatively most reasonable decision. Therefore, according to the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law and judicial interpretations, and comprehensively considering the actual circumstances of this case, the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court's acceptance of the above two patent infringement lawsuits complies with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law on territorial jurisdiction, and it has jurisdiction over this case. At the same time, from the perspective of ensuring and facilitating party litigation and facilitating the people's court to hear cases impartially and efficiently, this case should not be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for trial. As for whether there will be conflicts when the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court and the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court separately try the case for confirmation of non-infringement of a patent and the case for patent infringement, since appeals from both are uniformly heard by the Intellectual Property Court of the Supreme People's Court, this potential problem can be resolved through the appeal mechanism.

In summary, the grounds of appeal of Baoye Company that this case should be transferred to the Shanghai Intellectual Property Court for consolidated trial are insufficient in fact and law, and this Court does not support them according to law. Pursuant to Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item 1, and Article 171 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

Appeal dismissed, and the ruling of the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court in civil rulings (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu Nos. 3447 and 3448 rejecting the jurisdictional objection raised by Shanghai Baoye Group Co., Ltd. in case (2018) Yue 73 Min Chu No. 3448 is affirmed.

This ruling is final.
